changesets.summary: slopper profile, and public reads without a token
changesets.details: `slopper profile @username` prints anyone's open goal day by day, what's still to go, their streak and slops. It, `today`, `search`, `categories`, `tags` and `reviews` work without logging in, and send the token when there is one.

changesets.summary: Goal days end at midnight UTC
changesets.details: `slopper goal --days` help, `whoami`'s summary and the skill say every day on Slopper is a UTC day.

changesets.summary: Race tallies and anti-gaming rules for slop of the day
changesets.details:
- Slops keep raceUpvotes/raceDownvotes beside their totals: only votes cast on raceDate move them, so the tally stops when the day ends and the crown at 00:01 UTC ranks on it (convex/race.ts raceTally). Older slops fall back to their totals.
- Votes record inRace. countsInRace leaves out votes from accounts younger than LIMITS.raceVoterAge (a day), downvotes from makers with a slop in the same race, and swapped upvotes between two racing makers (the earlier one comes out of its tally too).
- The rules page, /today, llms.txt and the agent skill say what counts.

changesets.summary: Slop of the day counts only fair votes
changesets.details: Every vote still shows on a slop, whenever it's cast. The daily race now counts only the votes cast on its own day (votes in the minute after midnight used to slip in), and leaves out votes from accounts less than a day old, downvotes from makers racing the same day, and upvotes two racing makers swap. The rules page says what counts.

changesets.summary: Sharing to LinkedIn fills in the post
changesets.details: The LinkedIn share button opened an empty post box with only the link. It now opens LinkedIn's composer with the same text as the other networks, followed by the link.

changesets.summary: Public operations and per-address rate limits
changesets.details:
- Operations are `UserOperation` or `PublicOperation` (`app/.server/agent/operations.ts`); `runOperation` refuses a user operation without a user. REST serves public ones without a token; a bad token is still a 401 everywhere. MCP still needs a token.
- `apiQuota` (`app/.server/tokens.ts`) keys calls by user, or by `callerAddress` without one, with `LIMITS.apiCallsPerHour` and `LIMITS.anonymousApiCallsPerHour`; a 429 carries `Retry-After`.
- `users.profile` returns the owner's `today`.

changesets.summary: Look anyone up from the API without signing in
changesets.details: Anyone's profile, with their goal day by day, streak and slops, is now at `/api/v1/users/{username}` and the `get_profile` agent tool. That profile, today's race, search, categories, tags and reviews all work without an API token, at up to 120 calls an hour from one address. Signed in, everything works, at up to 1,200 calls an hour, and a call over the limit says when to try again.

changesets.summary: The skill looks people up with slopper profile
The skill says which votes count in the race

changesets.details:
- `insertLaunch` dates a launch itself: `launchDate` is the UTC date it went out, the same as `raceDate`. `slops.create` no longer takes `today`, and goal, profile, streak, scheduling and edit-window code use `utcDate` (app/lib/dates.ts). `timeZone` is only for clock times, typed wall times and the digest.
- `raceStartOn` and `localDayStart` are gone: the next free day starts at its midnight UTC.
- `launchDays.toUtcDays` (internal) lists launches whose `launchDate` was their maker's local date and, with `apply`, moves them onto their `raceDate` with their goal day; `launchDays.moveLaunch` backdates one launch for the e2e tests.

changesets.summary: Every day is a UTC day
changesets.details: Launches, goal days and streaks now all end at midnight UTC, the same moment for everyone, like slop of the day already did. A slop thrown at 23:55 UTC counts for that day even where it's already past midnight, so a late one no longer looks like a missed day. Settings shows times in your time zone, and the goal form says when midnight UTC is there.

changesets.summary: Page speed counts visits that leave early
changesets.details: A visit that left before the web-vitals chunk loaded or reported sent no `$webVitals`, so the quickest bounces were missing from /analytics/speed. It now sends the first paint and time to first byte the browser already has. The e2e speed test waits for the first paint instead of racing the chunk, and the scheduled-launch test polls for the content check's verdict instead of reading it once.

changesets.summary: Votes go through while slops are launching
changesets.details: A vote could fail with an error when lots of slops were launching at the same moment. It now goes through.
